definition.name: Verified Task Success Rate
definition.description: Proportion of eligible planned trials whose independently verified final state satisfies all task acceptance criteria.
definition.numerator_definition: Count of eligible trials independently verified as pass.
definition.denominator_definition: Count of eligible trials with an observed verification disposition; excludes predeclared invalidations, not run retries.
definition.eligibility_rule: Use trial-level eligibility defined in the frozen evaluation plan.
definition.missing_data_policy: Keep missing verification separate from pass/fail; report it in missing_trial_count.
